mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.route_op_id, e.seq, e.title, e.content, e.param_json, e.required_confirm_flag, e.status, e.create_time, f.id AS f_id, f.esop_id AS f_esop_id, f.seq AS f_seq, f.file_type AS f_file_type, f.file_name AS f_file_name, f.file_url AS f_file_url, f.file_id AS f_file_id FROM mdm_route_op_esop e LEFT JOIN mdm_route_op_esop_file f ON f.esop_id = e.id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.id = #{id} ORDER BY f.seq ASC

SELECT e.id, e.route_op_id, e.seq, e.title, e.content, e.param_json, e.required_confirm_flag, e.status, e.create_time, f.id AS f_id, f.esop_id AS f_esop_id, f.seq AS f_seq, f.file_type AS f_file_type, f.file_name AS f_file_name, f.file_url AS f_file_url, f.file_id AS f_file_id FROM mdm_route_op_esop e LEFT JOIN mdm_route_op_esop_file f ON f.esop_id = e.id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE e.deleted = 0 AND e.route_op_id = #{routeOpId} ORDER BY e.seq ASC, f.seq ASC
